title: WAF Bypass with MySQL Versioned Comments
learning_objectives: Recognise that a whole-word keyword blocklist is not a SQL injection defence
Hide SQL keywords inside MySQL versioned comments (/*!NNNNN...*/) to evade a regex WAF
Re-balance a LIKE string literal without using a blocked '-- ' or '#' comment terminator
Use /waf-log to confirm which OWASP-CRS-style rules fire before and after the bypass
flag_hint: Leak secrets.waf_bypass_flag with a versioned-comment UNION that evades the WAF, then GET /solve?flag=<value> (or ?token=<value>) returns the flag read from the flag file on a match; /waf-log shows which rules fired for debugging.
inspired_by: OWASP CRS bypass research by Christian Folini and the widely-shared 'sqli-labs' waf-bypass series
